# Allowlist for the docs-consistency check (.github/scripts/check-docs-consistency.sh).
#
# One name per line. A listed submodule or adapter subsystem is SKIPPED in every docs check,
# so the build does not fail while it is intentionally undocumented (a temporary or
# experimental addition). Remove the name once the docs catch up.
#
# `#` comments and blank lines are ignored. Example:
#   experimental-service    # remove after the coverage doc lists it
#
# (empty: every submodule and adapter is documented today)
